name: Bean and Poblano Gorditas

ingredients.name: roasted poblano or green bell pepper strips
vegetarian crumbly fresh cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Stir the salt into the masa harina. Gradually add 360 ml warm water and knead for 2–3 minutes until a soft, cohesive dough forms. Reserve the remaining 30 ml for adjusting if it cracks. Cover and rest 15 minutes so the masa hydrates.

Meanwhile heat 10 ml oil in a pan. Cook the chopped onion for 3 minutes, add cumin for 30 seconds, then add the drained cooked black beans. Mash about half the beans and cook for 4–5 minutes until thick enough to stay in a pocket. Pat the roasted pepper strips dry and chop the coriander. Check that the fresh cheese uses no animal-derived coagulants.

Divide the dough into eight equal balls. Press each between sheets of plastic into a thick round about 10 cm across and 12 mm thick. Smooth any cracks with a damp finger. Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat and cook the rounds for 4–5 minutes on each side until browned in places and fully cooked through; their thickness matters for making pockets.

Rest each cooked round for about a minute, then carefully cut a slit along one side and open an internal pocket with a small knife, leaving the other side joined. If the centre is still raw, put it back on the griddle briefly. Brush the outside of the gorditas with the remaining 15 ml oil and toast each side for 1 minute for a lightly crisp surface.

Spoon about 40 g of the warm bean mixture into each pocket, followed by roasted pepper strips, crumbled vegetarian cheese and coriander. Serve two gorditas per person with tomato salsa on the side. The filling belongs inside the split thick corn cake, unlike the toppings on an open sope.
tips: Do not flatten the masa as thin as a tortilla: the cooked cake must be thick enough to split. Keep the beans thick and peppers dry so the pocket does not tear. The reviewed photo shows several substantial side-split corn pockets with beans, green pepper strips and white cheese.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
